# Ryu (vendored)

Shortest round-trip double-to-string from [ulfjack/ryu](https://github.com/ulfjack/ryu).

Used under the **Boost Software License 1.0** (see `LICENSE-Boost`). Menard's
presentation layer (`runtime/src/float_text.c`) wraps `d2s_buffered` with the
canonical Float grammar from LANG-02.
